caption: Wilhelm II (left) in Russian uniform and his cousin Nicholas II in Prussian uniform, 1905 — the two emperors wearing each other's armies for the camera, nine years before those armies met. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a Bundesarchiv photograph.
credit: Original photograph: Bundesarchiv, Bild 183-R43302 / CC-BY-SA 3.0 (Allgemeiner Deutscher Nachrichtendienst — Zentralbild), 1905. Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026, under the same CC-BY-SA 3.0 licence.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-23. The photograph is often associated with the two emperors' meeting at Björkö in July 1905; the Bundesarchiv record itself gives only the year, so the caption does not claim the occasion. Natural placement is the July Crisis chain (the Willy–Nicky correspondence, sand-1l0.23, shipped in PR #60) and the prologue; used_by is deliberately empty because the validator warns on ids that do not yet exist for a placement that has not been authored.
